notes: *This ... that* is read as rule 20's identifying expansion of the single `הוּא`, headed on the first, with the copula going to the written predicate name.

The relative *who* is `added`: `בְנָיָהוּ` is a written antecedent and no relative, article or conjunction morpheme stands in the juxtaposed clause (rules 46 and 55). `גִּבּוֹר` stands in construct on `הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים`, so it is a substantive with its own dependent and rule 41's articleless attributive does not reach it.
The italic *of* before *his course* goes to the bare nominal under rule 33, no preposition morpheme standing in that clause.
